note: Book 3, step 2: replay against the interference of cpu-prefecture-capitals-span.json. The 28 same-name prefectures are split alternately: 14 become replay pairs (their own capital, scored on the city as the 8 trained ones), 14 stay untrained guards (examples/prefecture-capitals-split-replay.json; the other groups unchanged). Training pairs: examples/prefecture-capitals-train-replay.jsonl (the 8 + the 14). Every run, with and without replay, is compared against the untrained student by tools/compare_capitals.py with the replay split, so the no-replay runs show the 14 replay prefectures as ordinary guards (untrained: 14/14 forced right in both halves). Result: at a weak setting replay keeps the guards and costs nothing on the trained facts; at a strong setting it does not. Weak: LoRA 8 lr 1e-4 x 30 steps, same-name guards forced right 6 -> 13 of 14 with replay, free 3 -> 12; full FFN lr 1e-6 x 100, guards forced 7 -> 13, free 3 -> 11, the 3 different-name prefectures 3/3 forced, the 4 nearly-known trained capitals 4/4 free and forced, README KL 0.007 in both. Strong (LoRA 1e-4 x 100 or 300, full 3e-6 x 100): the replay pairs themselves are learned (13-14/14), but the untrained guards still collapse (3-8/14 forced), now also to the replayed cities (山形市, 山口市, 富山市): the top FFN memorizes the 22 answers as a pool instead of reading the prefecture. No held-out capital is learned in any run (facts do not transfer), and the trained not-known capitals need the strong setting (茨城 stays 仙台市 at the weak one). Free answers are cut at 16 tokens, so a few right answers in the frame (「…は**横」) are counted wrong.
